how_it_works: People ask why someone does not just get in line. This is the line. Each capped petition gets a place based on the day it was filed, and the table shows which day the government is working on now. Anything filed after that date is still waiting. A brother or sister of a U.S. citizen from Haiti filed in late 2011 is only now being reached — about fifteen years. For Mexico it is closer to twenty-five. Haiti is not listed separately, so it falls under "all areas." Spouses, minor children and parents of U.S. citizens are not capped and do not appear here at all.
